cash_tip: Locals say the standalone ATMs in Sayulita charge high fees, so use a bank ATM, always tap 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos, and take out one bigger amount instead of several small ones. Keep small bills on hand for tacos, taxis and the market (side note: the ATM at the San Pancho hospital is said to be the cheapest for US cards, about 60 pesos).
